newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan court bails out Bhutto father-in-law.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan court bails out Bhutto father-in-law.

text.p: A Pakistani court on Wednesday released ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto's father-in-law Hakim Ali Zardari on bail, his lawyers said.
"The high court has granted bail against 200,000 rupees as the charges filed against him lacked substantial evidence," lawyer Farooq Naik said.
Zardari, father of Bhutto's husband Asif Ali Zardari, was picked up by police from his home in Karachi in connection with a land scam.
Bhutto's husband has been under arrest since President Farooq Leghari sacked her three-year-old government on November 5,
